constraints.name: bending stiffness
constraints.text: transverse bending stiffness such that it has no more than 1 mm deflection under 25 N tip load as a cantilever beam (k >= 25 N / 1 mm = 25 N/mm, tip load along z)

constraints.name: buckling
constraints.text: does not buckle under a 50 N lateral bending load in a cantilever beam configuration (50 N x 1000 mm = 50,000 N mm root moment, lateral = bending in y, about the z axis; checked as a uniform end moment, which puts the root moment along the whole boom: conservative)

constraints.name: torsional stiffness
constraints.text: torsional stiffness such that it will not rotate more than 1 degree under 100 N*mm end torque (GJ >= T L / theta)

constraints.name: no failure under the torque
constraints.text: Hashin F < 1 under the 100 N mm torque (study step loadcases)

constraints.name: no failure: lateral50N
constraints.text: ensure no material failure throughout the simulation runs: Hashin F < 1 under the 50 N lateral (y) tip load, linear, cantilever

constraints.name: coiling on hub
constraints.text: coils on 100 mm hub (radius, user answer 2026-11-17)
